subject: Urgent: MediaSurge production throttling due to quota window misalignment
messages:
From: Samir Khan <support@mediasurge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <procurement@mediasurge.com>
Date: 2028-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Production: spike in 429s and tail latency  (MediaSurge)

Irene —

We're seeing a sudden spike in 429 throttles and a corresponding jump in 95th/99th percentile latency from our integration with Redwood since ~08:40 PT. Impacting ~40% of inference traffic; errors surface on both short and medium-length requests. Attached are a few sampled 429 lines and a latency chart.

Quick facts:
- First observed: 08:40 PT 2028-11-05
- Error: 429 Too Many Requests returned by Redwood API
- Symptoms: request retries lead to queueing inside our workers and downstream timeouts

Can you confirm whether any rate-limit or quota changes were deployed this morning? We did not change our client behavior. This is affecting an active campaign and we need immediate remediation and an ETA.

Thanks,
Samir
Support Lead, MediaSurge
Attachments: mediasurge_429_samples.log, prod_latency_chart_20281105.png
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <support@mediasurge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-05T09:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Production: spike in 429s and tail latency  (MediaSurge)

Samir —

Thanks for the quick signal and the log samples. I've looped in Monica (infra on-call) and Tessa (SRE escalation) to triage. We will:

1) Immediately examine quota/burst-policy changes pushed in the last 2 hours.
2) Temporarily relax burst caps for MediaSurge while we diagnose.
3) Confirm whether any routing/policy rollouts impacted the per-customer window mapping.

I'll update you within 30 minutes with an initial status. If you have exact request IDs or a specific time window to focus on, paste them here.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-05T09:38:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Production: spike in 429s and tail latency  (MediaSurge)

Investigating — preliminary findings:

- At 08:30 PT we pushed a policy refactor that standardizes quota windows across customers. The rollout included a default per-minute bucket and a shorter burst token window for a subset of accounts.
- It appears MediaSurge's integration relies on the older per-5s burst window; the mapping rule for accounts with custom billing tiers was accidentally omitted in the new policy translation.
- As a result, MediaSurge's effective burst allowance dropped to ~25% of their expected peak, causing synchronous clients to get 429s under normal bursty traffic.

Immediate mitigations applied at 09:35 PT:
- Reverted the mapping for MediaSurge to the previous per-5s burst window (temporary exception).
- Increased burst allowance for their account by 3x for the next 2 hours.

I am attaching the diff for the policy change (mitigation-config-diff.patch) and a short log excerpt. We need to:
- Push a fix to the rollout translation logic (root cause).
- Add a targeted test for accounts with custom billing tiers.

Will post a full RCA shortly.

—Monica
Sr. SRE
Redwood Inference
Attachments: mitigation-config-diff.patch
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-05T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Escalation: MediaSurge production impact — exec awareness requested

Marissa / Leadership —

Heads-up: MediaSurge experienced production throttling due to a quota-window translation bug in the policy refactor rolled at 08:30 PT. Monica has applied a targeted rollback and bumped burst limits as a temporary mitigation. Customer traffic is stabilizing but we are still seeing elevated retries.

Customer is asking for:
- Immediate credit/waiver for affected tokens over the incident window (09:00–10:00 PT)
- A written timeline and RCA within 24 hours

Action items I propose:
1) Approve a one-time top-off credit for MediaSurge pending final impact numbers (suggestion: 10% of last month’s usage to fast-resolve).
2) Prioritize the rollout translation fix as P0 for today.
3) Schedule a post-mortem with MediaSurge and share a mitigation plan.

Irene — can you confirm credit authority or route this to finance/sales?

—Tessa
Director, Reliability Escalations
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <support@mediasurge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <procurement@mediasurge.com>
Date: 2028-11-05T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Production: spike in 429s and tail latency  (MediaSurge) — immediate steps and offer

Samir —

Thank you for surfacing this, and apologies for the disruption. Summary of immediate remediation we've applied:

- At 09:35 PT we reverted the quota-window mapping for your account to the previous per-5s burst window and increased the temporary burst allowance by 3x.
- We will hold this exception while we deploy a translation fix to the policy refactor. Expected timeframe: 4–6 hours for fix + validation, then gradual rollout to avoid regression.

Proposed commercial remediation:
- We will issue a token credit covering the affected window (09:00–11:00 PT) and a one-time operational credit equal to 10% of your last month's usage while we complete the RCA. This is a gesture of goodwill while we finalize impact calculations.

Next steps:
1) Monica will deliver an internal RCA and a patch for the translation logic by EOD 11/05.
2) We will schedule a 30-minute post-mortem with MediaSurge tomorrow 11/06 to review root cause and long-term fixes.
3) Engineering will add a regression test (quota-window mapping + custom billing tiers) to the CI pipeline.

I'll follow up with formal incident notes and a timeline. Are you available for a short sync at 14:00 PT today?

—Irene
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Khan <support@mediasurge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <procurement@mediasurge.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-07T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Production: spike in 429s and tail latency  (MediaSurge) — post-incident confirmation

Irene / Monica —

Thanks for the quick response and for the credit offer. We saw significant improvement after the rollback and the temporary allowance — error rates returned to baseline within ~45 minutes of the mitigation.

A few follow-ups from our side:
- We'd like the post-mortem document and the code patch referenced in the mitigation diff. Please share the PR link and planned rollback window for the safe rollout.
- We also want a short SLA addendum clarifying how quota-window refactors will be communicated and tested for accounts with custom tiers.

Appreciate the fast handling — looking forward to the post-mortem tomorrow.

Best,
Samir Khan
Support Lead, MediaSurge
